Select retained kernel RPMs for reproducible runtime, installer, and extension builds.

- **standard:** `7.3.6-300.fc45.x86_64`

Signed RPMs for `4e54094cfda6db28f6c101352af988824ef7dbfd` were captured and retained by [Kernel Updates](https://github.com/katl-dev/katl/actions/runs/46037024474).

CI requires driver qualification (extension composition and the production DRBD tests) on this pull request and again in the merge queue, where the boot, lifecycle, and cluster VM tests also run, before merge. NVIDIA hardware behavior requires separate hardware qualification.
title: kernel: update retained standard kernel inputs
